zh-CN.title: 投稿邀请卡片适配气泡
items: 投稿邀请卡片现在会跟随发送者的气泡样式，适配对应的颜色、纹理、边框和圆角
不同邀请状态保持清晰可辨，并改善了深浅色气泡中的文字层级

en.title: Submission invites match chat bubbles
items: Submission invitation cards now follow the sender's bubble colors, textures, borders, and shape
Invitation states remain easy to distinguish with clearer text hierarchy across light and dark bubbles
